transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hello. Well, I came in today because I seem to be spending far too much of my day just... opening the same folders and drawers over and over again. I have these labeled boxes with important papers and keepsakes, and I just keep checking to make sure they are exactly where I left them. And the thing is, I'll do it even when I just checked them a few minutes before. It's just taking up so much of my time.
Do you feel anxious or distressed when you're not able to check the folders and drawers, or while you're doing these checks?

Yes, I do. It's... well, it's very distressing. Even when I know better, a thought will just keep needling me. I'll start thinking that maybe I accidentally threw away my late husband's old tax papers, or that I somehow put a cherished family recipe in the wrong box. And I just can't seem to let the thought pass without feeling like I've done something terribly careless. So I have to go look.
